fairUse.rationale: Small co-designer-sourced cover identifies the game discussed in this starting-rule article; it is used for editorial reference with no more artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: Co-designer and Queen Games editor Wolfgang Dirscherl displays this exact original box on his 3 February 2015 launch announcement at https://lupo-games.de/index.php?Itemid=72&id=61&option=com_content&view=article. His announcement identifies Queen Games, the Queen Kids line, fellow designer Manfred Reindl, the 2015 release, and artists Claus Stephan and Michael Hüter. The official Queen Games English rulebook https://rules.queen-games.com/push-a-monster_en.pdf confirms the same game, cover logo, creators and components. This image is directly hosted on the designer’s own site, not a retailer or image index. Reduced to 323 × 360 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently saw a monster goes first.
officialTieBreak: If the group cannot agree who starts, the youngest player begins.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The starting player rolls the die. Turns continue clockwise.
